patterns: Halloween behind-the-scenes POV twist: I_Muhammadali44's 'POV: You're filming a terrifying Halloween horror movie... until someone yells CUT! / The demon was just doing his job' reached 26K (Wed 10:16, Kling 4.0 on @itsPolloAI). Scary setup, comedy reveal, then a question CTA ('What other horror plot twists can we pull?')

Dark fantasy mother and creature bond: RoxaHQ's 'She Gave Birth to a Dragon, The Mother's Monster | AI Dark Fantasy Short Film' hit 8K in 20 hours (Thu 14:03), the only new over-5K post in the last 24h. It echoes SadiaMalik182's 'She raised it in secret, fed it by hand' (8.5K). A woman protecting a forbidden creature is a proven dark fantasy hook

Series beats hook phrases: lexx_aura's 'Another Malfoy episode' grew from 64K to 95K and 'Malfoy is always angry' to 187K, but the same 'This AI video is absolutely masterpiece' hook without Malfoy ('They say Ai can't do Art', Thu 14:56) only got 1.6K in 19h. The recurring character is what drives the views, not the hook line

Halloween is tomorrow (Sat 31 Oct): Kling 4.0 Halloween clips are big outside the watchlist (adricazoorla 44K Wed 12:25, szounft 60s short 34.5K Wed 11:25), and mr_farman_ai's Midnight witch is at 941K. Today is Halloween Eve, the last day the countdown framing works

Posting discipline: @phulskamp posted 8 originals in 48h, best 39 views (Gate of Eternity, Thu 10:50); this morning three cosmic posts went out within 41 minutes (06:56-07:37) and got 4-34 views each. 🕯️ THE LANTERN WITCH, EPISODE 4 🕯️

Tonight the village locks its doors,
she walks alone on hollow moors.
One lantern left, one flame to keep,
she'll wake the ones who should not sleep.

drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10-12s. Second 0: extreme close-up of the witch's blue lantern flame flaring up in total darkness, lighting her eyes from below. Then she walks across a misty moor past a village with every window going dark one by one, stops at a field of old gravestones, raises the lantern, and pale hands start pushing up through the soil as the flame turns green.

drafts.title: 🐉 THE DRAGON SHE HID FROM THE KING
drafts.text:
They ordered her to burn the egg. She raised him instead. 🐉👇

🐉 THE DRAGON SHE HID FROM THE KING 🐉

They told her burn the egg by night,
she hid it far from torch and light.
Now when the soldiers break her door,
a dragon rises from the floor.

Prompt: 10s vertical 9:16, dark fantasy, a hooded young woman in a candlelit stone cellar shields a glowing black dragon egg, years pass, soldiers kick in the door, a huge black dragon rises behind her and spreads its wings.

drafts.title: 👻 THE GHOST WHO WANTED ONE MORE TAKE
drafts.text:
POV: you're filming a haunted castle scene for Halloween... until someone yells CUT. 🎬👻👇

👻 THE GHOST WHO WANTED ONE MORE TAKE 👻

The candles died, the doors swung wide,
a ghost rose up, the crew ran to hide.
Then someone yelled CUT down the hall,
he grinned and asked, 'Should I redo the fall?'
